title: 听力挑战 · 备考策略交流

rounds.speaker: 学生
rounds.line: For detail questions, I first locate the keywords in the passage and then compare them with each option.
rounds.lineCn: 做细节题时,我先在文章中定位关键词,再把它们与每个选项逐一比对。

grammar.name: 细节题定位法
grammar.note: 先找关键词定位,再比对选项;them 指代 keywords,理解指代有助于抓取做题步骤。

options.text: He finds keywords first and then compares options with them.
options.feedback: 他的做法是先定位关键词,再与选项比对。

options.text: He reads the whole passage once and answers without checking.
options.feedback: 他说的是先定位再比对,并非不检查就作答。

options.text: He guesses the answers from the title directly.
options.feedback: 他没有提到根据标题猜测答案。

rounds.speaker: 辅导老师
rounds.line: The main idea question asks about the general theme, so you should not focus on specific examples.
rounds.lineCn: 主旨题问的是文章大意,所以你不应把注意力放在具体例子上。

grammar.name: 主旨题解题思路
grammar.note: 主旨题抓整体主题,细节例子是干扰项,答题时要抓大放小。

options.text: Focus on the general theme rather than specific examples.
options.feedback: 主旨题应抓大意,不被具体例子干扰。

options.text: Focus on specific examples and figures in the text.
options.feedback: 老师提醒不要关注具体例子,这是细节题做法。

options.text: Skip the main idea question without answering it.
options.feedback: 老师并未建议放弃主旨题。

rounds.speaker: 学生
rounds.line: I often confuse inference questions with detail questions because both require careful reading.
rounds.lineCn: 我经常把推断题和细节题搞混,因为两者都需要仔细阅读。

grammar.name: 推断题与细节题的区分
grammar.note: 推断题需根据原文推理引申,细节题只需直接定位,抓住解题依据的区别。

options.text: He mixes up inference questions and detail questions.
options.feedback: 他承认经常把两类题型弄混。

options.text: He thinks inference questions are always easy.
options.feedback: 他并未评价推断题的难易程度。

options.text: He never reads the passage carefully.
options.feedback: 他说两类题都需要仔细阅读,并非不细读。

rounds.speaker: 辅导老师
rounds.line: To improve speed, practice skimming for structure first and reserve deep reading for key paragraphs.
rounds.lineCn: 为提高速度,先练习略读把握结构,把精读留给关键段落。

grammar.name: 略读与精读结合
grammar.note: skim 抓结构与 reserve 精读形成对比,动名词作宾语,理解层次化阅读策略。

options.text: Skim for structure first, then read key paragraphs deeply.
options.feedback: 先略读把握结构,关键段落再精读。

options.text: Read every paragraph word by word from the start.
options.feedback: 逐词通读会拖慢速度,与建议相反。

options.text: Avoid skimming because it wastes time.
options.feedback: 老师主张用略读提速,而非回避略读。
